note: The tasks a Coder One or Microluna policy was tuned on, measured on, or studied for lessons. `coder-one contamination lexicon` builds the reference corpus from these tasks' instructions and workspace comments; `coder-one contamination check` compares every phrase list and every prose text the static check reads with it. A task belongs here once any policy change could have read its trace, its workspace, or its result, including held-out and confirmation tasks: a phrase that matches their text is listed even when nobody read it, because the phrase would still fire on that task. No prompt reads this file.

roles.dev: The Microluna development set: iterated on from v8 to v17, and its traces motivated changes. docs/terminal-bench/2026-09-24-microluna-iterations.md, Protocol.
roles.held-out: The Microluna test set, run once on microluna-v15. Its traces were read only after grading. docs/terminal-bench/2026-09-24-microluna-iterations.md, Held-out test set.
roles.family: The pre-registered Luna-sized family, run on microluna-v15 and microluna-v18. bench/terminal-bench/experiments/2026-09-25-luna-sized-family/protocol.md and docs/terminal-bench/2026-09-25-microluna-v18-family.md.
roles.iteration: Named in a Microluna job from v1 to v18 outside the sets above, or in the v12 and v13 retained-candidate runs. ~/.openagents/terminal-bench/jobs.
roles.anatomy: Studied for decisive facts in the task anatomy, which Coder One's tunable policies drew lessons from. docs/terminal-bench/2026-09-24-task-anatomy.json.
roles.recall-study: A target of the check-recall study (checks::labeled::TARGETS). docs/terminal-bench/2026-09-23-check-recall.md.
roles.tunable: Named in a Coder One tunable policy's history as the task a change was made for. docs/coder/design/prompt-audit.md, Policy notes.
